name: KiCad Project Manager
description: Review template updates, prepare board releases, record local PCB checklists, and manage rules and stackups.
description_full: A native KiCad 9 and 10 companion for versioned KiBot templates and reusable standards. Review shared template files and editable project documents in a resizable workspace, compare reference and planned changes with colored diffs, retain accepted customizations and refresh without losing compatible drafts. Edit project metadata, workflow status and impedance tables, import missing guidance matching the saved board, compare design rules and physical stackups, and save a board construction as a reusable preset. Prepare board release notes and versioned text variables in Project Setup. Record a generic local PCB checklist with reviewers, comments and an optional completed-review snapshot, without Git or a standards source. Update shared template files while preserving project documents. Optionally check template and standards Git sources in the background and pull explicitly with local-edit protection. Changes use local backups and conflict detection. Enable the KiCad API in Preferences → Plugins. Select a Python interpreter with pip, venv and wxPython, using the bundled interpreter for AppImage installations. Save and close PCB and schematic editors before applying standards.
